figures.caption: Figure 1: Structural dynamics under spreading activation. The plots show the ratio of explored nodes k/N required to reach a target R(k)/N , where R(k) is the number of empirical words that has to be recovered within the first k positions of the predicted sequence. The vertical dashed line highlights the model requiring the least exploration of the real sequence, with its r and µ reported in the legend. The black dashed line shows the random acquisition baseline.
Figure 6: Persistence (c) and burstiness (d) values compared to the ground-truths, horizontal line.

Figure 2: Structural dynamics under shortest paths. The plots show the ratio of explored nodes k/N required to reach a target R(k)/N , where R(k) is the number of empirical words that has to be recovered within the first k positions of the predicted sequence. The vertical dashed line highlights the model requiring the least exploration of the real sequence, with its µ reported in the legend. The black dashed line shows the random acquisition baseline.

Figure 5: Distances between ground-truth and simulated persistence (a) and burstiness (b) as a function of the parameter µ. Red and blue areas identify statistically significant regions (p < 0.05), but only points falling within the blue area indicate model configurations closer to the ground-truth sequences.

Figure 3: Average normative age of acquisition (in months) per CDI, shown in ascending order. Category abbreviations — Act: Action Words; Adv: Adverbs; Anm: Animals; Bdy: Body Parts; Clt: Clothing; Cnt: Connecting Words; Dsc: Descriptive Words; F&D: Food & Drink; Fnt: Furniture & Rooms; Gms: Games & Routines; Hlp: Helping Verbs; Hsh: Household; Loc: Locations; Out: Outside; Plc: Places; Ppl: People; Prn: Pronouns; Qnt: Quantifiers; Qst: Question Words; Snd: Sounds; Tm: Time Words; Toy: Toys; Vhc: Vehicles.
Figure 4: Transition matrices between CDIs, using the same ordering as in Figure 3. Labels are omitted for readability. White cells indicate no transitions, darkness is proportional to probability.
